method: Injected Chromium, actual production fixed-step physics, seed-paired first-to-7 CPU matches, 180 simulated-second cap. No score/time manipulation; no network or human-trial claim.
acceptanceNote: 180 seconds is a fixed comparison window, not a promised match duration. Completed full matches, including any required longer observations, are checked separately in full_matches.json. Initial all-within-180 target and observations retained in development.

reanalysis.note: The original 180s completion target failed for three split cases. Scoring in the fixed window and separate extended full matches are evaluated explicitly; raw observations are unchanged.
